# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For WinForms dashboard work, prioritize close visual fidelity to the supplied reference image, accurate control sizing/layout, and prefer Designer-serializable native controls/layout. Preserve existing control names, event handlers, authentication, data bindings, and real data sources. Keep database logic out of InitializeComponent and avoid adding UI packages. Ensure the dashboard layout and controls are serialized in Admin.Designer.vb so opening Admin.vb [Design] displays the actual dashboard; avoid constructing the visual UI entirely at runtime in Admin.vb.
- For the Super Admin dashboard, treat the project's existing Admin form and its Designer implementation as the primary visual reference. Keep changes limited to Super Admin files unless a shared-control fix is essential, and preserve Super Admin-specific navigation, permissions, live data, and logout/session behavior.
